Package neqsim.process.util.optimizer

Class InstalledEquipmentCapacityEvidence

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.util.optimizer.InstalledEquipmentCapacityEvidence
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class InstalledEquipmentCapacityEvidence extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable installed-equipment capacity evidence for one completed process-model operating point.

Normalized feasibility is deliberately separated from physical engineering evidence. Utilization and normalized margin are dimensionless, while current value, applicable limit, physical margin, and required relief use getPhysicalUnit(). The snapshot contains no supplier or equipment reference and therefore remains stable after later process runs, equipment mutation, Java serialization, or JPype inspection.

Required relief is the non-negative physical change needed to reach the applicable limit at the sampled point. For a maximum-directed limit it is max(0, current - limit); for a minimum-directed limit it is max(0, limit - current). It is a constraint residual, not a capacity-sizing recommendation, production-loss estimate, shadow price, economic value, or operating approval.

1.0

  • Constructor Details

    • InstalledEquipmentCapacityEvidence

      InstalledEquipmentCapacityEvidence(String areaName, String equipmentName, String equipmentClassName, String referenceDesignation, String constraintName, InstalledEquipmentCapacityEvidence.ConstraintOrigin constraintOrigin, CapacityConstraint constraint, double currentValue)
      Creates one frozen capacity snapshot from an already sampled current value.
      Parameters:
      areaName - process area name
      equipmentName - equipment name
      equipmentClassName - fully qualified equipment class name
      referenceDesignation - IEC 81346 reference designation, or empty when unset
      constraintName - equipment-local constraint name
      constraintOrigin - direct or strategy-generated origin
      constraint - installed capacity definition
      currentValue - current value sampled exactly once by the caller
